title: Historical Telgraph Mod
description: A simple telegraph-based communication system using cable-connected machines. Requires Simple Voice Chat.
body:
---

# 📄 **Description**

## Telegraph Voice Relay (Forge 1.20.1)

**Telegraph Voice Relay** adds a basic communication system inspired by early telegraph networks.

Players can connect telegraph machines using cables and transmit messages across a network, allowing simple long-distance communication in multiplayer environments.

---

## Features

* Cable-connected telegraph machines
* Network-based message transmission
* Command-based messaging system
* Audio and particle feedback
* Built-in cooldown to prevent spam

---

## How It Works

* Place telegraph machines
* Connect them using cables
* Use a command to send a message
* All connected machines receive the transmission

This system is loosely based on early wired communication methods, where messages were transmitted over physical connections.

---

## Dependency

This mod requires Simple Voice Chat.

* Must be installed on both client and server
* Provides the voice communication system used by the mod

---

## Important Notes

* Items are **not available in the Creative Inventory**
* You must obtain them using commands:

```id="x0uy0p"
/give @p <item_id>
```

---

## Compatibility

* Minecraft Forge **1.20.1**
* Designed for multiplayer use
* Compatible with mods that support voice-based gameplay
